messages:
maya: Heads up — we're seeing a sudden spike in 503s from the CDN edge in eu-west-2 and a correlated increase in GPU pod OOMs on the serving fleet. Latency for most hosted endpoints is up ~3-4x. Investigating.
kevin: On it. Which CDN provider? Any patterns by POP?
maya: It's our primary CDN (FastNet). Errors concentrated on eu-west-2 edge POPs; other regions look fine. Traffic appears to be re-routing into eu-west-1 and eu-central which is pushing queue depth on those clusters.
olivia: Noted. I see a wave of prefix cache misses for large-model requests — KV cache eviction rate jumped at 11:08 UTC. That will increase memory pressure on GPUs.
raj: Can we throttle non-critical routes to buy time? Suggest reducing burst capacity for /embeddings and low-priority routes.
sam: Agree. Pushing a short-lived rate-limit change now.
infra-bot: Rate limit change applied: policy=emergency-shed, routes=[/embeddings, /rerank], limit=50r/s per org.
kevin: I also see autoscaler behaved aggressively — it scaled up node groups in eu-west-1 but pod scheduling lagged due to shortage of specific GPU SKUs (A10G pool almost full). Scheduling pressure -> some pods restarted.
maya: Can we failover a portion of traffic to Dedicated clusters (reserved capacity) while we stabilize? Those have spare A100s.
raj: Dedicated requires ACL flip. Olivia/kevin do we have an automated route for partial traffic shift?
olivia: We have a traffic policy but defaulting to dedicated needs TTL changes on the edge and a health-check passback. I'm prepping a canary rule for 10% traffic to dedicated.
kevin: I can push the canary. Executing:
```
# switch 10% -> dedicated (canary)
redwood-route update --from=hosted --to=dedicated --percent=10 --policy=prefer-dedicated --dry-run=false
```
kevin: Done. CDN configs will pick this up in ~30s.
maya: Good. Meanwhile, ops tip: enable model-quant quickpath for big-model endpoints to reduce memory by ~25% for inference. Olivia, can you trigger quant-mode=fast on canary rollouts?
olivia: Applying quant-mode=fast on canary models. Command:
```
redwood-model patch --model=rw-large-v2 --config="quant_mode: fast"
```
olivia: Patch applied to canary subset.
deploy-bot: [11:15:22 UTC] autoscaler-event: nodegroup-eu-west-1 scaled +8 -> new size 42. Reason: CPU/GPU pressure.
kevin: After canary flip, error rates drop on hosted endpoints by ~18% in the next 2 minutes. Still seeing a small number of OOM restarts — those are on instances that lost disk-backed cache during restart.
maya: Any KMS/HSM impacts? We need to ensure key access isn't adding latency.
raj: No KMS errors in logs. FastNet appears to be the only third-party failing. No HSM faults.
sam: Cost note — moving 10% to Dedicated will increase short-term cost vs hosted bursts but better reliability. We should track incremental spend.
kevin: Agreed. I'll open a short-lived billing alert for the next 24h to monitor.
maya: Ops checklist for follow-up:
- confirm FastNet root cause with provider (kevin)
- maintain canary at 10% until all edge POPs stable (olivia)
- throttle low-priority routes for 45m (raj)
- monitor GPU pod restarts and evictions (sam)
- billing alert (kevin)

kevin: Filed FastNet ticket TKT-9821 and requested RCA. Provider acknowledged a configuration push to eu-west-2 POPs at 11:00 UTC correlated with the issue.
olivia: Edge health improving. CDN error-rate down to normal in eu-west-2 at 11:42 UTC. Can start ramping down emergency measures.
raj: Rolling back rate-limit: set back to normal for /embeddings.
infra-bot: Rate limit change applied: policy=standard-shed, routes=[/embeddings, /rerank], limit=350r/s per org.
kevin: Can we gradually move traffic off Dedicated back to hosted to avoid a big thundering herd? Suggest 10% steps every 5m.
maya: Do it. Coordinate with Olivia for model config sync.
olivia: Rolling 10% steps now.
kevin: Last metrics look green: p50 latency within SLO, error-rate at baseline, GPU OOMs returned to normal.
maya: Closing incident — will post postmortem when provider RCA arrives. Thanks all. :tada:
sam: Quick note for postmortem: add a runbook step to proactively enable quant-mode fast for large-model traffic during edge blips.
maya: Added.
kevin: Closing monitoring alert.
deploy-bot: [12:06:29 UTC] incident-closed: 1763456789 by maya."
